# FeFETDifferentialBitCell

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A differential bit-cell architecture using ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) that combines volatile and non-volatile storage modes in a single cell for synaptic weight representation. This hybrid storage approach balances retention and reconfigurability, essential for efficient on-chip learning and inference in neuromorphic accelerators.
